explanation:
# Power and IR report: uart (signoff)

Source: reports/power_tool.json only (OpenSTA `sta` 2.6.0 power runs, one per corner, plus the OpenLane power total and IR figures). No number below was computed or adjusted by me.

## Power by corner (input activity 0.2)

| Corner | Internal (W) | Switching (W) | Leakage (W) | Total (W) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| tt_025C_1v80 | 0.0005378256 | 0.0002504456 | 6.027401e-09 | 0.0007882774 |
| ss_100C_1v60 | 0.000427865 | 0.0001944777 | 5.42591e-06 | 0.0006277686 |
| ff_n40C_1v95 | 0.0006140556 | 0.0002976594 | 1.150402e-08 | 0.0009117265 |

OpenLane reports a separate power total of 0.0008120654383674264 W. It differs from the tt STA total (0.0007882774 W). The input data does not say why, so I do not explain it here.

## IR drop

- Worst drop: 0.00087 V
- Average drop: 0.000153 V
- Limit: 0.09 V (5% of 1.8 V, the A.13 Phase 0 default)
- The worst drop is below the limit, so the tool data shows no limit violation and no PDN change is proposed to Grid.

## Assumptions and what is not covered

- Switching activity is the default 0.2 (20%) input activity from the tool data. No simulation activity (VCD/SAIF) was provided, so the numbers are not workload-specific. A real UART workload (idle line, baud_div, parity mode) could give different power.
- Corners analyzed for power: tt_025C_1v80, ss_100C_1v60 and ff_n40C_1v95, as named in the tool data. Leakage is largest at ss_100C_1v60 (5.42591e-06 W).
- The IR figures come from one run. The input does not state which corner, the voltage-source (pad/strap) locations, the current-map method or the PDN model used. I cannot confirm these and the data does not give them.
- The IR limit is measured against the 1.8 V nominal supply. The limit_rule field gives the basis as 5% of 1.8 V.
- Not analyzed by the open flow and not reported here: electromigration (EM), dynamic or vectorless transient IR drop, package and board parasitics, and on-chip decap effects. EM and IR on other supplies or corners remain unchecked.
- The tool logs and commands are listed in power_tool.json for each corner, for reviewer audit.
assumptions: Switching activity is the default input activity 0.2 (20%); no simulation activity was supplied.
Power corners are tt_025C_1v80, ss_100C_1v60 and ff_n40C_1v95 as given in power_tool.json; all numbers are quoted from that file.
IR limit is 0.09 V, i.e. 5% of 1.8 V (A.13 Phase 0 default), as stated in the tool data.
Voltage-source locations, IR corner and PDN model are not stated in the input; they are not assumed here.
The open flow does not analyze electromigration (EM) or transient/dynamic IR drop, so those are not covered.
open_issues: OpenLane power total (0.0008120654383674264 W) differs from the tt STA total (0.0007882774 W); the cause is not given in the input data.
IR analysis conditions (corner, voltage source locations, current model) are not documented in the input; a human should confirm them.
No simulation-based activity is available; power at the default 0.2 activity may not represent real UART traffic.
EM is not checked by the open flow.
